detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure Cloud edge logs via provider TA with the modular input for `google:gcp:pubsub:message`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.15.1.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `messageId` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=aws sourcetype=google:gcp:pubsub:message.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="google:gcp:pubsub:message" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="google:gcp:pubsub:message"
| table _time messageId publishTime attributes
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.15.5_edge_cdn_waf_gcp_cloud_c_5"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `google:gcp:pubsub:message` in `index=aws` to detect edge cdn waf gcp cloud cdn cache hit drop. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the provider cloud console audit view for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `messageId` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_15_5_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Cloud edge logs via provider TA and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
